title: Trump makes new promises on gas prices as Iran war reaches 60-day mark
summary: CBS on gas prices at the Iran war's 60-day mark: president promises a rapid drop when the war ends while prices hit their highest since 2022 heading into summer.

assertions.quote: The gasoline, the oil will go down rapidly as soon as the war is over.
US gas prices have been climbing for 9 straight weeks from an average of $2.98 a gallon in late February to $4.39 a gallon now
before we get into the summer months when gas prices tend to get more expensive anyway

verdicts.note: Summer blend requirements and driving demand lift US gasoline prices most years from spring into summer.

Prices do rise from winter toward summer (May above January in 15 of 16 years 2010-2025), but the seasonal peak is typically late spring, not midsummer: May was at or above August in 13 of those 16 years (2024: May 3.603, Aug 3.389; 2019: 2.859 vs 2.621), so prices usually plateau or drift down during the driving season itself.

assertions.quote: they are now at their highest point since mid-2022
